title: France, Netherlands and Belgium expanded traffic-sign artwork
attribution: Wikimedia Commons contributors; national road-code authorities as referenced by each set manifest
license: Per-file public domain, CC0 or CC BY/CC BY-SA with commercial use permitted under the declared terms
changes: Owner-approved Commons renditions are retained as SVG and rasterized locally to transparent PNG. The expanded sets reach the German 111-entry baseline: 114 FR, 111 NL and 115 BE files including preserved core/transition signs. Country-specific regulation URLs, file-page provenance, hashes, commercial-use decisions and attribution requirements are recorded in national/FR, national/NL and national/BE manifests. These assets are not runtime model packs.
